step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows telemetry data from Vizio Smart TVs being ingested and analyzed in AWS. 1. Smart TVs (drawn on the far left) send logs, performance telemetry, and user usage data to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams (labeled KINESIS). 2. Kinesis Data Streams passes the data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose (labeled KINESIS FIREHOSE). 3. Kinesis Data Firehose outputs the raw data directly down into Amazon S3 for long-term storage and forwards data to Amazon Redshift for data warehousing. 4. Amazon Redshift delivers aggregated query results down into Amazon QuickSight for visualization and reporting.

graph.name: Vizio Smart TV Data Ingestion and Analytics Architecture
graph.notes: Architecture processes billions of monthly events from millions of connected Vizio TVs using Kinesis Data Streams, Firehose, S3, Redshift, and QuickSight.
